description:
Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
At Salesloft, our Senior GTM Engineer is pivotal to turning signals into pipelines. You will be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering, with real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. 

We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, and now we need someone who builds. You will own the systems that connect our data (Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks) to action (Salesloft Rhythm, Marketo, LeanData), turn buying signals into plays reps actually run, and put AI agents to work on the busywork that slows marketing, sales, and CS down.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for building and running the GTM systems that drive the pipeline. Specifically, you will:

  • Build and maintain integrations and workflows across Salesforce, Salesloft, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, 1mind, and Tines.
  • Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.
  • Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.
  • Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.
  • Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.
  • Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

  • Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.
  • Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING 

  • 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.
  • Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.
  • Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.
  • You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.
  • You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.
  • Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.
  • You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.
  • A background in marketing ops or RevOps before moving into engineering.

THE TEAM
You’ll be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering. We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. You’ll hear “Yes, let’s do that!” and then have the opportunity to execute on your ideas.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at  https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

#LI-Remote

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.  

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. 

Base Pay Range
$87,000—$149,000 USD
